name: CloudConvert
summary: File conversion across 200+ formats (documents, images, audio, video, archives), plus optimize, merge, thumbnails and website capture, run as jobs of tasks.

api_key.description: A CloudConvert API key (dashboard > API keys), scoped as needed: user.read, task.read, task.write. Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Async flow: jobs.create returns at once with status 'processing'; poll jobs.get, or call jobs.wait (sync host) to block until 'finished' or 'error'. Output file URLs are in the export/url task's result.files.

A job is a set of named tasks wired by 'input': typically import (import/url, import/base64, ...), a processing task (convert, optimize, merge, ...), and export (export/url, export/s3, ...). Imported files are stored only temporarily.
Conversions spend credits; users.me shows what is left and each task reports its credits. Do not retry failed tasks automatically: CloudConvert already retries retryable errors.
Creating jobs is rate limited: X-RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining headers, and 429 with Retry-After.
The sandbox (sandbox.api.cloudconvert.com) is free but takes only whitelisted files and needs a sandbox key; this entry calls the live API.

endpoints.name: Get the account and remaining credits
endpoints.summary: The current user, with remaining conversion credits.

endpoints.name: List supported conversions and options
endpoints.summary: Every operation, input/output format pair and engine, with credits and options; filter to check whether a conversion exists.

operation.description: Operation name, e.g. convert or optimize.

endpoints.name: Create a conversion job
endpoints.summary: Start a job of import, processing and export tasks; answers at once with the job in status 'processing'.

tasks.description: Tasks keyed by a name you choose ([A-Za-z0-9_-]); each has 'operation' (e.g. import/url, convert, export/url), optional 'input' (names of earlier tasks), 'ignore_error', and the operation's own options. At most 2000 tasks.

tag.description: Your own label for the job.

notes: A write: it spends conversion credits, and export tasks can upload results to your storage (S3, Azure, FTP, ...). Needs the task.write scope.
Then poll jobs.get or block on jobs.wait.

endpoints.name: Get a job's status
endpoints.summary: A job and its tasks, with status waiting, processing, finished or error, and result files when done.

redirect.description: true to answer with a 302 to the output file; needs an export/url task.

endpoints.name: Wait for a job to finish
endpoints.summary: Blocks until the job is finished or failed, then returns it with its tasks.

redirect.description: true to answer with a 302 to the output file; needs an export/url task.

notes: On sync.api.cloudconvert.com. Not for long jobs such as video encodes: the connection can time out; poll jobs.get instead.

endpoints.name: List jobs
endpoints.summary: Recent jobs, filtered by status or tag.
